name: Xano
description: Monitor Xano backend activity — verifies API request logging and audit events via the Metadata API.

config.setupInstructions:
1. Find your Xano instance base URL — the domain of your Xano instance, e.g. https://x8ki-letl-twmt.n7.xano.io (paste the domain only, no extra path). It's visible in your browser while working in Xano.
2. Create a Metadata API access token: in Xano go to Account Settings > Metadata API > Manage Access Tokens > Generate New Access Token. Grant it at least the "Request History" (read) scope (add "Audit Logs" for change-event evidence). Copy the token — it is shown only once.
3. (Optional) Workspace ID — leave blank to auto-detect your workspaces, or enter a specific numeric workspace ID (visible in your Xano workspace URL).
4. Enter the instance URL and access token below.

credentialFields.label: Instance Base URL
credentialFields.helpText: Your Xano instance domain, e.g. https://x8ki-letl-twmt.n7.xano.io (domain only, no path).

credentialFields.label: Metadata API Access Token
credentialFields.helpText: Account Settings > Metadata API > Manage Access Tokens. Needs the "Request History" (read) scope.

credentialFields.label: Workspace ID (optional)
credentialFields.helpText: Leave blank to auto-detect all workspaces, or enter a specific numeric workspace ID.

checks.name: Monitoring & Alerting
checks.description: Verifies Xano is logging API request activity (and audit events) via the Metadata API request history.
